'''The Paddocks''' was a large open-air market in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. It was established for the auction and sale of various forms of livestock, although it evolved into an informal [[Zoo/Legends|zoo]] over the years. During the height of the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]], the Paddocks was owned and operated by [[Cruegar]], a [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] who knew his clientele and their needs.
